name: expr_impure_side_effect
why: DIVERGENCE PROBE: impure but not classically denylisted. The Python allowlist counts this; a denylist may wave it through.
divergence: ARCHITECTURAL. scanner.py ast.parse()s the expression and applies an allowlist (is_pure_value_expression); scanner-ts has no Python parser and regex-matches a DANGEROUS_IDENTIFIERS denylist, so 'destroy' passes. The SERVER (submit gate) is the permissive side. Not closable by adding identifiers -- the denylist is unbounded. Decision needed: parse Python in TS, move the expression scan to a Python worker, or amend C8 to declare TS a coarse pre-filter with Embody-side authoritative.
